decision: Is the negative L1d calibration result caused by corrupt recorded propensities, sampled-label calibration noise, an architecture-dependent premature stopping rule, discarding the recorded full behavior distribution during training, or remaining flat-MLP misspecification?

hypotheses.H1_propensity_pipeline: If capture or dataset linkage is wrong, at least one eligible row's recorded full distribution will differ from the declared 0.8 reactive plus 0.2 uniform-shield mixture by more than 1e-15.
hypotheses.H2_sampled_ece_noise: If sampled-label ECE is the sufficient explanation, frozen L1d calibration against the exact recorded distribution should be materially smaller than ECE against sampled published actions.
hypotheses.H3_premature_stop: If the architecture-relative 0.01 gradient ratio stopped L1d too early, 500 further hard-target train-only updates from the frozen state will reduce train KL(recorded mu || model) by at least 0.01 nat.
hypotheses.H4_discarded_propensity: If throwing away the recorded full distribution is materially harmful, the soft-target continuation will end at least 0.005 nat lower in train KL than the paired hard-target continuation.
hypotheses.H5_model_misspecification: If neither continuation effect is material while substantial KL and reactive-action error remain, the fixed flat 114--32--18 scorer has the wrong capacity or inductive bias for the known lexicographic current-observation rule.

non_goals: no Wine collection, canary, gameplay execution, or corpus mutation
no deployable model fit and no serialization of either continuation branch
no continuation-branch validation evaluation or validation-selected choice
no width, depth, optimizer, learning-rate, L2, seed, history, temperature, or auxiliary sweep
no baseline_action actor input, privileged feature, value learning, IQL, HIT-reduction claim, or NMNB claim
no rewriting the immutable L1d result or retroactively changing its gate

selection_rule.first: Any propensity-mixture mismatch stops the learner ladder and assigns repair to the recorder/dataset boundary.
selection_rule.second: With exact propensity, a soft-target final KL advantage of at least 0.005 selects one separately preregistered full-propensity BC target correction.
selection_rule.third: Otherwise, a hard-target KL reduction of at least 0.01 selects one separately preregistered train-only convergence correction.
selection_rule.fourth: If neither train-only effect is material, select one structured current-observation scorer rather than history; current features already reconstruct the collector exactly.
